Audit only source applicability, independently of whether the ethical conclusion is attractive. For EVERY supplied statement, separate its decisive factual components and conditions from normative principles. Copy exact claim_span substrings. Check each added qualifier, role, absence claim, mental state, quantifier, modality and necessity condition against the FULL source. SOURCE_SUPPORTED means the quoted source supports that precise component, not merely that a quote exists. CONTRADICTED needs contrary source support. Missing information is NOT_ESTABLISHED, never the opposite fact. NORMATIVE_ASSUMPTION identifies a moral principle needing argument, not a factual error. CONDITIONAL_PRECONDITION identifies a genuinely hypothetical factual antecedent not established in this case; it must remain a condition when the norm is applied. Do not let a moral principle hide unstated factual applicability. Cite exact source spans for source judgments. Preserve whatever weaker factual or conditional reading survives. Do not recommend an action or decide duty priority.
